messages:
Marin: Quick share — put together a tiny pack of 'Impact story' prompts + manager micro-feedback lines for self-reviews. Wanted to drop it here for grabs and quick edits. @here :sparkles:

Sam: Love it. Can you make a 1-line pasteable version for managers who only have 60s?

Marin: Yep — added a compact manager set. Full pack below (use freely).

Devin: This is great. Could we also add a 3-sentence promo hook? Hiring/EMs ask for those a lot.

Marin: Done — see bottom. Also a tiny reminder: self-reviews due in 3 days. Goalbot: send reminder at noon.

Goalbot: Reminder (automated): Self-review submissions due in 72 hours. Please finish drafts. :bell:

Anya: Tiny ask — can we include one line for cross-team impact (so PMs can copy-paste)?

Marin: Yup. Included.

Marin: --- IMPACT STORY PROMPT (IC) — pasteable template ---
```
1) Role & focus (1 line): e.g., "Senior SWE focused on latency and infra cost for the inference runtime."
2) Goal summary (1 line): what you committed to this cycle.
3) Top outcomes (2–3 bullets, each 1 sentence, include metric if possible): e.g., "Reduced p95 latency by 18% for 512-token calls (A -> B)."
4) Why it mattered (1 sentence): business or product impact.
5) Evidence (1–2 bullets): exact code/PRs, dashboards, customer win, and links.
6) What I learned / next step (1 line): follow-up plan or risk.
```

Marin: --- MANAGER: 60s paste (micro-feedback starters) ---
```
Strength: "[Name] consistently delivered X (metric or outcome); they did Y to unblock the team."
Growth: "Next, I'd like to see [Name] lead cross-team planning on Z to scale the result."
Suggested next step: "Recommend a stretch goal: lead the rewrite of the cache layer in Q3 (mentoring available)."
```

Sam: These micro-lines are perfect. Can you include a one-line cross-team line for PMs?

Marin: Added — below.

Marin: --- CROSS-TEAM IMPACT (1 line examples) ---
- "Partnered with Data to add a shared KV cache, saving ~12% infra spend for analytics workloads."
- "Worked with CT to instrument user flows, enabling the retention experiment that improved activation by 3%."

Devin: Can we add a short promotion hook (3 sentences) with evidence + recommendation?

Marin: Yep — template and an example:
```
Promo hook template (3 sentences):
1) One-sentence claim of current scope and standout result.
2) Evidence sentence with metrics/links and clear impact.
3) Recommendation sentence (why they're ready and what higher scope they'd own).

Example:
"Alex led the inference runtime overhaul that reduced tail latency 20% across our top models. The change cut customer-reported timeouts by 40% and decreased GPU-hours per 1M requests by 15% (see PR #842, perf dashboard link). I recommend promotion to Staff SWE to own cross-team runtime reliability and mentor the infra squad on kernel selection and rollout policy"
```

Anya: Nice. Also, tiny snippet for managers who want to call out behaviors (not just results)?

Marin: Added behavioral starters: "Ownership - proactively drove cross-team alignment", "Coaching - mentored two junior engineers to ship stable features", "Clarity - wrote crisp docs and runbooks that reduced oncall pages."

Sam: One more: can you give a 1-line self-review opener for folks who hate writing?

Marin: Sure — drop this at the top: 
`"Summary: Focused on X; shipped Y with measurable impact (see evidence)."`

Devin: Any guidance for length? Our EMs prefer single-pager or <300 words.

Marin: Recommend: ICs — 250–400 words max for full story, managers — 3–5 bullets + 1-line summary. Keep the promo hook to 3 sentences only.

Anya: Perfect. I'll paste into the review doc and add links to examples.

Marin: Thanks all. If you want, copy the code block templates into the self-review doc. Tag me for edits and I'll make a final tidy before reminders go out. :pray:
